description: This Java source file defines the public interface 'Message' within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.messages' package. The interface specifies methods for creating and accessing properties of a message object that models communication to or from a 'Thing' or its 'Feature' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for headers, payloads, metadata such as timestamps and correlation IDs, and related attributes. The interface also provides a static factory method for constructing message builders.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for a Message instance with specified headers.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with this message, including client-specific and user-defined headers.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload of the message, if present.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the raw payload ByteBuffer, if present.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing additional data included via signal enrichment.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the MessageResponseConsumer associated with the message (deprecated).

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the message, indicating if it's sent FROM or TO a Thing or Feature.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Deprecated. Returns the thing ID as a string; use getThingEntityId() instead.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId object representing the entity involved in the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature ID involved in the message.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the content type of the payload.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the message timeout duration.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the message's correlation ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the HTTP status code of the message.
